G3038832.description: Vila (Catalan pronunciation: [ˈbila]) is a village in Andorra, located in the parish of Encamp.

G3038999.description: Soldeu (Catalan pronunciation: [solˈdew]) is a village and ski resort in Andorra in the Pyrenees mountains, located in the parish of Canillo.

G3039077.description: Sispony (Catalan pronunciation: [sisˈpoɲ]) is a village in Andorra, and one of the country's 44 official poblacions. It is located in the parish of La Massana.

G3039154.description: El Tarter (Catalan pronunciation: [el taɾˈte]) is a village in Andorra and one of the country's 44 official poblacions. It is located in the parish of Canillo.

G3039181.description: Santa Coloma d'Andorra (Catalan pronunciation: [ˈsanta koˈloma ðanˈdɔra]), also known as Santa Coloma, is an Andorran town in the parish of Andorra la Vella, located near the Gran Valira river and 2 km away from the capital, Andorra la Vella.

G3039604.description: El Pas de la Casa (Catalan pronunciation: [el ˈpaz ðe la ˈkaza]; French: Le Pas de la Case) is a ski resort (part of the Grandvalira resort), town, and mountain pass in the Encamp parish of Andorra, lying on the border with France.

G3040051.description: Les Escaldes (Catalan pronunciation: [lez esˈkaldes]) or Escaldes is an urban area in Escaldes-Engordany parish, Andorra. It is located near the nation's capital, Andorra la Vella.

G3040067.description: Les Bons (Catalan pronunciation: [lez ˈβɔns]) is a village in the parish of Encamp, Andorra. The Romanesque church Església de Sant Romà de les Bons is located within the village.

G3040141.description: L'Aldosa de la Massana (Catalan pronunciation: [lalˈdoza ðe la maˈsana]), known simply as L'Aldosa, is a village in Andorra, located in the parish of La Massana. The church of Sant Ermengol de l'Aldosa is located there.

G3040154.description: La Cortinada (Catalan pronunciation: [la koɾtiˈnaða]) is a village in Andorra, located between the villages of Arans and Ansalonga in the parish of Ordino.

G3040609.description: Erts (Catalan pronunciation: [ˈɛɾts]) is a village in Andorra. In 2024, the Council of Ministers allocated funds to widen a 120-m stretch of carriageway on General Road 4 (CG-4) between Erts and La Massana.

G3041519.description: Arinsal (Catalan pronunciation: [aɾinˈzal]) is a village in Andorra, set at an altitude of between 1550 and 2560 metres, close to the border with Spain at Tor, Pallars. In the summer Arinsal is home to walkers and bikers, as well as those who just want to relax in the mountain scenery.

G3041543.description: Anyós (Catalan pronunciation: [aˈɲos]) is a village in the parish of La Massana, Andorra. It is the third-most populated place in the parish with 1,047 people and has experience a significant amount of population growth since the 2010s.

G3041563.description: Andorra la Vella is the capital and largest city of Andorra. It is located high in the east Pyrenees, between France and Spain.

G3041604.description: Aixirivall (Catalan pronunciation: [ajʃiɾiˈβaʎ]) is a village in the parish of Sant Julià de Lòria, Andorra. First mentioned in 1176, the village is host to the Romanesque church Església de Sant Pere d'Aixirivall and an ethnology collection with over 1,000 objects.
